items.title: Content ideals exist and are principal for a flat finite module over an essentially finite type local map out of a valuation ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an essentially finite type local map out of a valuation ring and a finite flat module, every element has a content ideal, which is moreover principal (statement lines 5800-5808, tag 0ASX). The proof is a genuine reduction: the principal statement follows from finite generation and the characterization of valuation rings, while existence is reduced to the henselization by observing that the localisation of the base change is faithfully flat and hence membership in ideal multiples is detected after the change, and then transferred back using the inclusion preserving bijection between ideals under the henselization and the content statement in the henselized case. The faithful flatness reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
